scope: Retrospective same-state direct retention comparison on the existing four saved reads for each difficult sequence 8, 11, 20 and 23. Existing automatic initial prompts, raw-window states and the fixed seq23 no-inset viewport are unchanged. These sequences and reads were previously inspected.
intervention: Each read has exactly 5,120 eligible historical memory tokens in five verified source spans. Retain exactly 4,096 by each fixed selector and remove the other 1,024. Keep all other tokens, positions, prompt memory, newest memory and object pointers unchanged and in original order. All reduced arms have the same attention-key count. Full read is a no-reduction reference, not a matched-key baseline. Use the indexed-RoPE implementation to obtain original grid indices from the retained memory positions.
arms: Frozen Lean usage ranking; foreground/background unweighted FPN contrast plus usage; distributed sources and spatial positions; RGB contrast plus usage; unweighted contrast shuffled independently within each source, preserving the original token IDs and usage scores; three-region; and prompt-conditioned, descriptor-independent and mismatched-descriptor trained channel-gate contrast plus usage. Identical deterministic tie handling and 4,096 eligible-token capacity. The 15-frame-trained gates remain exploratory. Include a full-read no-op and an all-eligible-token-retention no-op engineering check.
verification: Unit-test selector complements, token/position pairing, protected spans and pointers. Require verified score reconstruction, old no-op equality, exact eligible count, equal key count, two independent fresh-process replays, source and score integrity and independently rescored masks. Open target labels after replay outputs are frozen. Report per-frame present Dice, labeled-empty false alarms, retained-set overlaps and limitations.
interpretation: This retains fewer historical keys at one fixed attention read, not in a persistent memory bank. Small sample results and initial prompt limitations prevent interpreting as a full-video performance or patient-generalization estimate. A result must outperform both generic and unweighted controls on held-out evidence before considering video propagation. No redetection, new confidence gate or new inference threshold.
